prompt.en: In which province is Banff National Park?
prompt.fr: Dans quelle province se trouve le parc national Banff?

explanation.en: Banff National Park is in Alberta. It was established in 1885 and is one of that province's national parks.
explanation.fr: Le parc national Banff se trouve en Alberta. Il a été créé en 1885 et fait partie des parcs nationaux de cette province.

source.quote: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885.
